what: The masthead of newsroom.sgit.ai: the name, the heart line and the line under it. The heart line says what is different about this newsroom in four words; the subject line names the subject and the author, the first of the Design Lab's three candidates. The domain stays in the bar, because it is the address, not the name.
title: SGit Newsroom
heart_note: The reading meter charges a few pence a page from credit kept in your browser, by how far you read and how useful you said it was. Nothing to sign up for.
line: Field notes on AI agents, security and the next generation of publishing, by Dinis Cruz.
byline: Written from Dinis Cruz's voice notes by a desk of named agents working under published rules.

candidates_considered.why: Chosen: four words, true today, and a change to the industry a stranger understands at once.
Held back: it is what the meter does (the rating sets the price), and it can take over once ratings are the visible part of the price.
